subject: Request: short extension + onboarding credits for Westbridge POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@westbridge.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.patel@westbridge.ai, procurement@westbridge.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short extension + onboarding credits for Westbridge POC

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our side. Our procurement team has hit an internal review delay (legal signs off next week), which means the POC window you provisioned will lapse before we can fully spin up. The pilot is going well from our engineers' side (attached usage snapshot), but without an extra 2–4 weeks we won't hit the KPIs needed to justify the follow-on commitment.

Would Redwood consider: 1) a 30-day trial stretch and 2) a one-time onboarding credit to cover burst usage so we can finish the integration and measurement? We were hoping for something in the range of $25k in credits to keep the test meaningful. In exchange we can commit to a commercial review immediately after the extended window and prioritize a procurement signature.

Attached: Westbridge-SOW-draft.pdf, usage-report-aug2027.csv

Appreciate any flexibility — if there's a short internal approval path we can move quickly.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director of ML Platforms, Westbridge AI
liam.oconnor@westbridge.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@westbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + onboarding credits for Westbridge POC

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and the snapshot. Great to hear the engineers are seeing traction.

We can be flexible here, but this is a combined concession (time + credits) which requires an internal approval because it affects promotional allowances for the quarter. I'm looping in Marissa and Ben to scope the ask and recommend terms. If we can align on a short set of conditions (commit-to-review date, success criteria, and a follow-up commercial cadence), I expect we can expedite.

Proposed conditional approach for internal discussion:
- 2-week extension to the POC (start date stays the same, end +14 days)
- Bonus onboarding credits: $20k one-time (applied to hosted usage)
- Condition: Westbridge executes the updated SOW and schedules a commercial review by Sep 10, 2027; if we see the agreed KPIs, we cadence to a purchase decision.

Ben / Marissa — quick thoughts? If you're OK I'll pull together an approval memo for Marissa to sign and route to execs.

Best,
Hannah
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: short extension + onboarding credits for Westbridge POC

Hannah / Ben — thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed the usage and pipeline notes; Westbridge is a strategic target in our enterprise vertical and the broader ARR opportunity is real, but we need to guard promo leakage this quarter.

Summary & recommendation for exec review:
- Ask: 30-day extension (they asked 30d; Hannah countered 14d) + ~$25k requested credits.
- Recommendation: Approve a 14-day extension + $20k onboarding credit, conditional on the updated SOW and a signed commit-to-review by Sep 10. Offer a 10% first-year volume discount if Westbridge converts to a 6-month reserved capacity within 60 days after the POC.
- Financial impact: $20k credit + 10% discount on first-year estimated consumption (~$15k expected NRR reduction in Q3).
- Upside: materially higher likelihood of converting to a committed reserved contract; prevention of churn on a large strategic pipeline.

I've prepared a short approval memo (approval-memo.pdf attached). I think this falls under approval authority that can be routed to Vivek for final sign-off; Vivek — can you weigh in? If approved, Hannah will finalize the SOW and send a DocuSign for the amendment.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short extension + onboarding credits for Westbridge POC

Thanks for the context and the memo — I appreciate the clear tradeoffs. Given Westbridge's fit and the probability uplift if we remove this friction, I approve a concession with a small tweak to protect net revenue. Approved terms:
- 14-day POC extension (no further extensions beyond this).
- $18,000 one-time onboarding credit (applied against hosted usage).
- 8% first-year volume discount (instead of 10%), conditional on signed 6-month reserved capacity within 60 days after POC and execution of the updated SOW.

Please document these conditions in the SOW amendment and require procurement sign-off in the DocuSign so credits only post-signature. Hannah — please proceed and include the approval memo in the record. Also make sure legal adds the clause about credits being applied only after invoice issuance to avoid premature consumption accounting.

Vivek
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@westbridge.ai>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@westbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, procurement@westbridge.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: POC extension + onboarding credit — next steps

Hi Liam / Sara — good news: leadership approved a limited concession to keep the POC moving. Final approved terms below: 

- POC extension: 14 calendar days added to the existing window (no further extensions).
- Onboarding credit: $18,000 one-time credit applied to hosted usage (credited after DocuSign sign-off and invoice issuance).
- Additional commercial incentive: 8% first-year volume discount if Westbridge signs a 6-month reserved capacity within 60 days post-POC.

Next steps for Westbridge procurement (to lock these terms):
1) Please review and sign the attached SOW amendment in DocuSign: https://docusign.net/XYZ123 (expires Aug 24).
2) Ensure the signatory includes procurement contact so credits can be applied after invoice issuance per the SOW clause.
3) Schedule the Sep 10 commercial review (we'll include technical outcomes and next-step pricing).

I've attached the updated SOW (westbridge-final-sow.pdf) and included the approval memo from Marissa in the packet. If procurement needs a slightly different signing flow, loop Ben and me and we can accommodate server-to-server or PO workflow.

Appreciate the quick coordination — looking forward to closing this out and getting Westbridge into a committed arrangement.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: westbridge-final-sow.pdf
